ScopeManifest.goal: Pure parser/refusal: legal current single-surface proposal returns ParsedProposal; invalid input returns DiagnosticRefusal without replay, training or provider effects.
ScopeManifest.measurement: Original fixed parser input/result controls cover allowed input, duplicate keys, stale source, outside/protected target, missing fixed input and extra effect/credential fields. In the historical compiled delivery, parser execution had not yet been implemented and its proposed controls remained NOT_RUN. Current pure parser public API evidence is recorded separately in docs/parser-verification.json; compilation checks do not promote those historical controls.
ScopeManifest.persistence: 原十項parent REQ與whole Goal持續保留，不因這個atom完成而閉合。
ScopeManifest.stop_and_escalation: 缺必要 fixed inputs 時，parser 回 DiagnosticRefusal，不進入依賴該輸入的候選處理。Local 工作超出原 user/task 授權時，停止該操作。Native Stage 缺原 Issue/admission 或合法 next 時，只停止該 native 操作；不阻塞獨立且已授權的 local parser 工作。Unknown write outcome 回原 Owner readback，不猜 next 或重送。
ScopeManifest.causal_change: Make raw proposal parsing and fixed mutation/acceptance boundary checks unambiguous before any later Runner consumes the data.
acceptance: With Owner-fixed boundary inputs, return only ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal; preserve original immutable references and report the refusal condition; neither variant causes replay/training/provider writes.
constraints: All ten original parent requirements and whole-Goal measurement persist; this atom covers only parser/static-boundary clauses.
Original Source/authorization Producers own reference truth and permissions; parser shape/consistency is not source truth, native admission or outcome acceptance.
prompt_delta: Parse only the selected single-surface raw proposal against original fixed inputs; produce ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal with a diagnostic condition.
Reject duplicate keys, stale expected source, targets outside the allowlist or protected acceptance, missing fixed inputs and extra credentials/effect fields; preserve the original references.
Do not start replay, training, native transfer or provider effects; preserve the ten parent requirements and report later obligations separately.
Within the actual authorized scope and selected playbook, choose implementation details freely; do not reconstruct original next or retry an unknown write.
ScopeManifest.entry: 原 user/task 已授權 local parser implementation，所需 Owner-fixed boundary inputs 與 raw proposal 可用。只有另行啟動 native Stage 時才需原 Issue/admission、已選 runtime playbook 與合法 next。
ScopeManifest.exit: ParsedProposal or DiagnosticRefusal only; actual parser controls and no-effects evidence required before a local implementation PASS.
callers_consumers: Patch Proposer produces raw data; it cannot self-certify acceptance.
Parser/Patch Validator returns data to a later original Runner; Runner is outside this atom.
ScopeManifest.rollback: Restore the pre-change parser implementation through its original source owner if implementation controls fail; no replay/provider state is created by this atom.
ScopeManifest.landing_owner: Original repository/provider owner; specification review and parser control PASS do not authorize landing or close parent Goal.

covered_parent_clauses.REQ-source-integrity: Preserve fixed Goal/acceptance/TaskSnapshot/rights references; no source inventory or rights adjudication is implemented.
covered_parent_clauses.REQ-three-planes: Parser output is read-only; it does not run Execution or produce a VerificationResult.
covered_parent_clauses.REQ-trainability: Only raw parse and static mutation-boundary checks; reproducible task replay remains pending.
covered_parent_clauses.REQ-scoped-patch: Consume the original FailureScope/allowlist/capability references; do not prove the hypothesis or regenerate upstream scope.
